P1_e12_squared_equals_neg1.note: e12^2 = -1 in Cl(3,0); fundamental bivector constraint; both tools must agree

P2_e12_squared_is_pure_scalar.note: e12^2 must survive as pure grade-0; bivector components excluded from result

P3_e1_times_e2_equals_e12.note: e1*e2 = e12; grade-0 and other grade-2 components excluded from admissible result

P4_anticommutativity_e1e2_plus_e2e1_zero.note: e1*e2 + e2*e1 = 0 in Cl(3,0); anticommutativity is constraint, not convention

P5_rotor_sandwich_stays_grade1.note: Rotor sandwich product must survive in grade-1; scalar/bivector components excluded

P6_rotor_rotation_angle_sympy_verified.note: R*e1*~R = -e2 at half-angle pi/4; sympy and clifford agree on sign convention

P7_pseudoscalar_squared_neg1.note: e123^2 = -1 in Cl(3,0); pseudoscalar constraint; excluded from +1 family

N1_e1_squared_positive_not_negative.note: e1^2 = +1 in Cl(3,0); vector generators are excluded from -1 family

N2_e1e2_not_commutative.note: e1*e2 - e2*e1 = 2*e12 ≠ 0; commutativity is excluded for distinct generators

N3_z3_grade_mismatch_UNSAT.note: Grade-0 + grade-2 sum cannot have grade-0; structurally excluded (UNSAT)

B1_identity_rotor_no_rotation.note: Identity rotor boundary: e1 survives as e1, not rotated

B2_bivector_sum_grade2_boundary.note: Sum of two bivectors stays grade-2; scalar excluded from boundary sum

B3_e12_times_e23_equals_e13.note: e12*e23 = e13 boundary product; sympy and clifford must agree to 1e-10
